description: This is a Java source file defining a REST controller class 'BookController' for a book-tracking web application. It handles HTTP requests related to books, including listing, retrieving by ID, adding, updating, and deleting books. It also defines converters for mapping string parameters to enum types and dependencies injected via Spring annotations.

classes.name: BookController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller managing CRUD operations for books in the application.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all books, optionally paginated.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a book by its ID, throwing a 404 error if not found.

methods.name: addBook
methods.description: Creates a new book entry from provided DTO, returning the saved book.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing book with fields from a patch DTO.

methods.name: convertToBook
methods.description: Converts a BookDto to a Book entity using ModelMapper.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a book by ID, returning an appropriate response.
